QuestInfo.name: A Second Gift for the Dragon Master
QuestInfo.0: When you reach Lv. 45, #p9010010# starts talking to you...
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9010010##k congratulates you for reaching Lv. 45 and tells you that she will give you a scroll that can be used when you reach Lv. 50.
QuestInfo.2: You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says she will give you another scroll if you reach Lv. 60 by #bMay 4#k.

0.0: Wow! Evan, you've already reached Level 45? That was much faster than I expected! When you reach Level 50, be sure to come see me and I will give you a scroll that can be used on the #t1022097#, as I promised before!
0.1: You do know where I am, right? Just come to a town. I'm always here.

no.0: Hmm. You're not implying that you don't like the gift that I, #p9010010#, prepared for you, right?

1.0: You've come! My, you really have grown! And the Dragon also looks nothing like it used to. Although, it's still really cute...
1.1: Now, let me give you the gift that I've prepared. It's a scroll that can only be used on the #t1022097#. I made it myself, of course.

yes.0: Hehehe... Actually, this isn't the end of my scrolls. I'm never cheap with my gifts! I could give another one to you now, but that'd be no fun. Get to #bLevel 60 before May 5th#k this time. I will give you another scroll that you can use on the #t1022097#.

default.0: Your Level is still a bit low; When you reach Level 50, you can receive a special gift that will only be given out during the event period. The event ends on May 4th, so be sure to hurry.
